elaine: Heads-up: planning partial-index + backfill during the 00:30-01:00 UTC maintenance slot tomorrow. need quick coord: image pin, canary scope, rollback criteria.

deploybot: window reserved: 2024-07-10 00:30->01:00 UTC. job=partial_idx_backfill_2024_07. runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/partial-index-backfill :white_check_mark:

mike: will this use concurrent index create or temp-copy+swap? we need to know lock profile.

db-admin: creates temp index then atomic rename. rename holds a short ACCESS EXCLUSIVE metadata lock ~50-200ms. backfill chunks use rate cap 3k rows/min.

ops-bot: preflight checks queued: replica_lag<40ms, disk_headroom>25%, migration_tests pass. will post 30m prior.

tara: propose canary on tenant shards [2,3] (~3%). pause after first shard for manual check. rollback triggers: any metadata lock >500ms OR write errors >0.8% sustained 2m.

elaine: ops please pin images: migration-runner@sha256:aa11bb and schema-tool@sha256:cc22dd before unpause. feature flag set OFF until canary unpaused.

deploybot: pins applied and canary configured. will annotate unpause message.

ops-bot: preflight: replica_lag=18ms, disk=38%, tests OK.

elaine: GO at 00:20 UTC; unpause at 00:25 if all green.

deploybot: canary unpaused at 00:25. shard 2 done: median chunk 11s, no errors.

deploybot: paused at canary checkpoint awaiting manual continue.

tara: metrics look clean, no lock spikes. continue.

deploybot: ramping to 100%; progress reports every 2m.

deploybot: rollout complete. status=SUCCESS. elapsed=18m.

db-admin: verified no lock incidents. cleaning temp indexes.

elaine: great. will prepare internal release note: "Partial index rollout: safer swap, controlled canary." leaving thread open 1h for delayed errors. :party:
